events.text: First Half begins.
Own Goal by Gonçalo Inácio, Sporting Lisbon. Sporting Lisbon 0, Galatasaray 1.
Sergi Altimira (Sporting Lisbon) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Aleksey Batrakov (Galatasaray).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Sporting Lisbon 1, Galatasaray 1. Geny Catamo (Sporting Lisbon) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner.
Luis Suárez (Sporting Lisbon) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Eren Elmali (Galatasaray) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Sporting Lisbon 2, Galatasaray 1. Luis Suárez (Sporting Lisbon) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom left corner.
Substitution, Galatasaray. Rafael Leão replaces Leroy Sané.
Goal! Sporting Lisbon 3, Galatasaray 1. Rodrigo Zalazar (Sporting Lisbon) from a free kick with a right footed shot to the top left corner.
Substitution, Galatasaray. Deniz Gül replaces Aleksey Batrakov.

Substitution, Sporting Lisbon. Fotis Ioannidis replaces Luis Suárez.
